scope: Tiny deterministic local contracts; runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Retain observed zero and repeated values
cases.input_contract: Implement a nonnegative filter for Seq(100L,-5L,0L,100L,25L). Preserve input order and duplicate values. An empty input should remain empty.
cases.expected: The result is Seq(100L,0L,100L,25L), with four occurrences. Both 100-cent entries and the zero remain.
cases.verification: Assert the exact sequence and confirm the original five-element sequence is unchanged; also assert accepted(Seq.empty) is empty.

cases.title: Keep a rejected ledger
cases.input_contract: Split every input amount into accepted nonnegative and rejected negative sequences, preserving order within each output. Return both sequences instead of dropping rejected data.
cases.expected: The five-value fixture yields accepted four values and rejected Seq(-5L). Accepted size plus rejected size equals five, including an all-negative or empty fixture.
cases.verification: Assert both exact outputs, their combined count and an all-negative case with empty accepted output.

cases.title: Map a bounded numeric policy
cases.input_contract: For nonnegative Long amounts, return integer-cent five-percent fees rounded down. Reject a negative amount with IllegalArgumentException. Avoid multiplying by five before division, which could overflow on a very large Long.
cases.expected: Seq(100L,0L,100L,25L) maps to Seq(5L,0L,5L,1L). Long.MaxValue maps safely to Long.MaxValue/20L.
cases.verification: Assert the exact four fees, the maximum-Long case and rejection of Seq(-1L).

cases.title: Fold count and total together
cases.input_contract: Return occurrence count and checked Long total for a supplied sequence. Use an explicit tuple accumulator and Math.addExact for the total. Empty input returns (0L,0L); an overflowing total raises ArithmeticException.
cases.expected: The accepted fixture returns (4L,225L), while Seq(Long.MaxValue,1L) is rejected by checked addition.
cases.verification: Assert the two-component result, the empty identity and the overflow exception independently.

cases.title: Represent multiplicity in a Map
cases.input_contract: Return a map from amount to occurrence count without discarding repeated values. Compare maps by keys and counts rather than assuming iteration order. Empty input returns an empty map.
cases.expected: The accepted fixture yields Map(100L->2L,0L->1L,25L->1L); the sum of counts is four.
cases.verification: Assert exact map equality and reconcile all map counts to the accepted sequence size.

cases.title: Transfer the bag contract to grouped reporting
cases.input_contract: Given group/amount pairs, reject blank group labels, retain nonnegative amount occurrences and return per-group(count, total) using checked summary. Groups with only rejected amounts are absent from the accepted report and remain explainable through the rejection policy.
cases.expected: A100, A100, B0, B25, C-5 yields A:(2,200), B:(2,25). Report counts sum to four and totals to 225; a blank label is rejected even on a negative row.
cases.verification: Assert the complete map, both global reconciliations and the blank-label failure before filtering can hide it.
